description: This file re-exports several fetch-related helper functions and types related to network proxy handling, environment proxy configuration, and SSRF protection, for use by plugins that require wrapped fetch behavior.

methods.name: resolveFetch
methods.description: Resolves the fetch implementation to be used.

methods.name: wrapFetchWithAbortSignal
methods.description: Wraps a fetch function with abort signal support.

methods.name: withTrustedEnvProxyGuardedFetchMode
methods.description: Configures fetch to operate in a trusted environment proxy guard mode.

methods.name: hasEnvHttpProxyConfigured
methods.description: Checks if an environment HTTP proxy is configured.

methods.name: getProxyUrlFromFetch
methods.description: Extracts proxy URL from a fetch request.

methods.name: makeProxyFetch
methods.description: Creates a fetch function that routes requests through a proxy.
